name: Battle of Waterloo
description:
A 13-commander historical battle fought in 1815, with the French, Anglo-Allied and arriving Prussian commands divided by their real corps and reserves.
Map made by Codz and Incerus, modified by Sophie Games

value.title: Napoleon Spots the Prussians!
value.message: A column has been sighted at Chapelle-Saint-Lambert, three hours' march from Napoleon's right flank.

value.title: Bülow's Advance Guard Arrives
value.message: Losthin's 15th Brigade reaches the eastern approach and begins the march toward Plancenoit.

value.title: Pirch's II Corps Follows
value.message: Tippelskirch's 5th Brigade and its supports follow Bülow onto Napoleon's right.

value.title: Zieten Comes Down the Ohain Road
value.message: Steinmetz's 1st Brigade and the I Corps advanced guard descend on Wellington's left toward Smohain and Papelotte.
